messages:
maya: Quick async sync — hotpath sprint update. High level: kernel PRs, continuous batching tweaks, and KV cache prefetch. Putting out current blockers and owners. Please ping if you own any of these.

jamal: Kernel PR #432 is merged to canary but failing one perf test on p100s. I can take perf triage today, need help reproducing with the new batcher config.

anita: KV prefetch landed in staging yesterday. Observed ~7% tail-latency improvement on 512B inputs. Rolling to canary later today.

liam: I'm owner for continuous-batching feature flag rollout. Plan: enable 10% -> monitor token/sec and p95, then 50% tomorrow if stable. Need SLO alert thresholds from SRE.

sre-bot: @liam created alert: hotpath.batch.latency_p95 > 120ms for 10m -> pager to oncall.

jamal: @liam can you share the exact flag name? Also attaching the repro command:
```
./loadtest --model=redwood-7b --seq=2048 --concurrency=64 --batcher=continuous-v2
```

maya: Flag is `enable_continuous_batch_v2`. @anita can you confirm KV eviction settings for canary? We saw some early evictions during the last run.

anita: Eviction policy is LFU with grace 30s on canary nodes. I can bump grace to 120s if we see evicts during rollout.

ci-bot: CI: kernel#432 perf-test passed on x86, flaky on p100. See logs: https://ci.redwood/432/logs (:eyes:)

liam: I'll start 10% rollout in 15m. @jamal please coordinate perf repro, @anita please monitor KV evictions and set grace to 120s if needed. If latency spikes, I'll pause and revert `enable_continuous_batch_v2`.

maya: Thanks — last ask: owners for launch checklist items? Locking docs and PR owners here.

devex: Added checklist doc: https://docs.redwood/sprints/hot-slate -> PRs list + owners. I'll DM owners for final signoff.

maya: Great. If anything breaks during the 10% roll, revert flag and ping #eng-oncall. :thumbsup:
